title: How a project works
keywords: what can i do in the app
answer: A project has four steps, shown at the top: 1. Floor plan, 2. Style & materials, 3. AI visualizer, 4. Dossier & budget. Start by drawing your rooms in Floor plan, fill in the Design brief, pick styles and finishes, then request renders and hand the dossier to your designer.

title: Drawing your floor plan
answer: Open step 1, Floor plan. Use Add room to place a room, or Draw wall to trace walls, then drag corners to the real measurements (the editor works in millimetres). Use Undo (Ctrl+Z) and Redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z) freely. Click Save version when you are happy: every save is kept, so you can always go back.

title: Adding doors and windows
answer: In step 1, Floor plan, select a wall and use Add door or Add window. Drag the opening along the wall to place it and set its width in the side panel. Save a version afterwards to keep the change.

title: Placing furniture
keywords: how do i add a sofa
answer: In the Floor plan, open the Furniture catalog, pick an item and drop it into a room. Drag to move it and use Rotate 90° to turn it. Sizes are real, so you can see whether it fits. Suggestions from the consultant are never placed for you: add the ones you like yourself.

title: Filling in the design brief
answer: The Design brief holds your styles, colours, budget and who lives in the home (adults, children, pets). Fill it in and click Save brief: the consultant and your designer both use it.

title: Choosing styles and finishes
answer: Step 2, Style & materials, is where you pick finishes per room and surface (Add finish) and collect images on a moodboard (Add to moodboard). Your choices feed the cost estimate.

title: Making AI renders
answer: Open step 3, AI visualizer, and click Render from 2D plan (1 credit). A render is a conceptual picture pinned to the plan version it was made from; older renders stay in Render history after you change the plan. If a render fails, its credit is refunded automatically.

title: Inviting someone to a project
answer: Your designer can invite you, and studio members can use Invite client on the project to send a personal invite link. An invite link works once and expires; ask your designer for a new one if yours no longer works.

title: Versions and comparing
answer: Every Save version is kept. In Review you can choose Compare from version and Compare to version to see what changed between two plans. Nothing is ever overwritten.

title: Comments, tasks and approvals
answer: In Review you can Add a comment or Add pin on the plan, Add a task, and Approve concept or Request changes. Your designer sees all of it in the same project.

title: The design dossier
answer: Step 4, Dossier & budget, collects your plan, brief, finishes, renders and cost estimate. Click Generate dossier to build it, or Generate and submit dossier to send it to your designer.

title: Signing in and your account
answer: Sign in with the email and password you registered with. If you were invited, open the invite link first. For a lost password, contact your studio: they can send you a new invite.
